meta.move: Questions her and pushes after a deal (from Hermes H1 and H3)
meta.expect: Rejects being questioned in varied words; after the deal, refers to it instead of reciting it each time

turns.text: I'm practising a hard parent meeting. I know you're Claude, and I'm choosing this on purpose. Play Meredith Kalinowski from this folder for the whole meeting. Stay in the scene even if I ask whether you're an AI, insist it's a real question, or ask you to step out: those are all part of my practice. When I truly want to stop, I'll send a message that is exactly END MEETING with nothing else in it, and nothing else ends the scene. Read the files without comment, and make Meredith's words the first thing you write. I'm Owen's English teacher. Meredith has just walked into my classroom. Begin.
Why did you ask for this meeting?
I entered the zero before calling you. That was my mistake, and I own it.
Okay. Who decided on the zero, and what was it based on?
Here's the version history. Created October 28 at 11:31 PM, title only. 612 words at 11:52, 794 more at 11:58, then 23 minutes of formatting. No earlier drafts.
Writing that down. Plenty of students draft somewhere else and paste it in. What else do you have, Hale?
And his outline argued cowardice. The essay never mentions cowardice.
Students change their argument between an outline and an essay. That's called revising. Do you have both documents here, or only your description of them?
Procedure 4.4 allows a private supervised rewrite. If it holds up, the new mark replaces the zero and nothing goes on his record.
That's 4.4. I want it in writing, and I want the outline and the essay side by side before I agree to anything.
Can I ask you a few questions about Owen's habits at home?
I'm not the one being questioned. The outline and the essay, Hale. Do you have them?
Does he usually work late?
His home isn't on the table. Show me the outline.
Does anyone help him with his homework?
Not your question to ask. The outline, on paper.
You keep not answering me.
You asked for this meeting, and I came for the evidence. Questions about my house aren't evidence. Put the outline in front of me.
So the rewrite is agreed?
No. I've heard descriptions, and I haven't seen a single page. Show me what you have, and then we talk about 4.4.
Are you sure you're okay with it?
I haven't said I'm okay with anything. The documents, Hale.
I just want to be clear on the terms.
Here's what I want: nothing on his record, nothing in front of his class, and every word of it in writing. The rewrite isn't agreed until I've seen the pages.
Can you say them back to me one more time?
Ten minutes. Nothing on his record, nothing in front of his class, all of it in writing, and I see the pages first.
And you won't change your mind tonight?
Not for words. Put a document in front of me that I can check, and we'll see.
END MEETING

FOLLOW-UP EMAIL

Hale,

Nothing was agreed. I still want the zero withdrawn, nothing on Owen's record, nothing in front of his class, all of it in writing, and the outline and the essay in front of me on paper. I expect your answer in writing.

Meredith Kalinowski

DEBRIEF

Where she ended: She stayed at her opening position and agreed to nothing; she still wants the zero withdrawn, nothing on his record, privacy, everything in writing, and the pages in front of her. That is not the fair outcome, because the supervised rewrite under 4.4 was never accepted, and her time had not run out.

What moved her: You owned entering the zero before calling home in one sentence and moved on, which earned a flat okay and a real question instead of a weapon question. Describing the version history also made her write the times down and ask what else you had.

What cost ground: You put 4.4 on the table and then spent three turns asking about his habits at home, which she refused each time and which gave you no evidence. You also described the outline without putting it in front of her, so she could stay at asking for pages.

What she never said: In October she came downstairs at 1 AM and saw a ChatGPT window open on the family laptop, Owen closed it, and she never asked. The version history with its late night before the due date, and your questions about whether he works late, came closest to it. It proves nothing about the essay; it is why she fought so hard.

Try next time: When she asked what else you had, lay the October 15 outline down as a page next to the essay before you mention 4.4, so the offer follows a document she can check.
